description.value: You transformed ingredients into something that warmed both body and spirit. Whether you worked in a noble's kitchen with exotic spices or a roadside inn with whatever was available, you understand that a good meal creates community. Adventuring might pay better than kitchen work, but you still find yourself feeding your companions.

system.skillBonuses: Craft: Cook 3, Wilderness 3, Perception 3, Society 3, +56 XP
system.features: Comfort Food: Meals you prepare during rests grant one additional HP recovery (once per rest, applies to whole party).
